background.description: Sets the background of a render to a color.

palette.description: Sets the palette to use for the render. For a list of palettes, try `search type:palette`.

filename.description:
Sets the filename of the render.
When used in conjunction with `--format=zip`, each frame in the zip will be named `<filename>_<frame // 3>_<frame % 3>.png`.
The filename must be at most 64 characters long, and must be valid.

prefix.description:
Sets the default prefix of the render.
For example, `-p=text` is the same as rendering using `=rule`.

frames.description: Sets which wobble frames to use.

combine.description: Sets an image to combine this render with.

combine_background.description: Sets an image to set as the background for this render.

speed.description:
Sets how fast the render is.
Use % to set a percentage of the default render speed.

global_variant.description: Applies a variant to every tile.

autocrop.description: Clips tiles extending off the border of the render. Overrides --expand.

limited_palette.description:
Only uses colors used within tiles in the render.
        Vastly speeds up GIF encoding at the cost of breaking effects like blending modes and transparency.
        Does nothing with -b enabled.

crop.description: Crops the render on each side.

pad.description: Pads the render on each side.

gscale.description: Sets the scale of all sprites. Applied before variants.

upscale.description: Sets the scale of all sprites. Applied after variants.

verbose.description: Shows some extra stats about the render.

expand.description: Expands the render for tiles displaced with the `:displace` variant.

anim.description:
Makes the wobble frames independent of the animation.
The first number is how many frames are in a wobble frame, and the second is how many frames are in a timestep.

format.syntax: --format|-f=<format: gif | png | pdf | zip | tiff | webp>
format.description: Set the format of the render.

tileborder.description: Makes the render's border connect to tiles that tile.

boomerang.description: Make the render reverse at the end.
